artists.biography:
Paul Haslinger is a composer and musician born on December 11, 1962 in Linz, Austria and currently based in Los Angeles, California (USA).

After studying classical music in Vienna, Austria, he joined the German electronic music group Tangerine Dream in 1986.

perplexity.description:
The original Halt and Catch Fire (Original Television Series Soundtrack) by Paul Haslinger, released in 2016, is a defining work in the electronic and stage & screen genres. Drawing on Haslinger’s background as a former member of Tangerine Dream, the score is characterized by its lush synth textures, atmospheric soundscapes, and evocative melodies that mirror the show’s 1980s tech-boom setting. The music blends retro-futuristic elements with emotional depth, creating a sonic backdrop that is both nostalgic and forward-looking, perfectly complementing the series’ themes of innovation and personal transformation.

This album stands as a significant entry in Haslinger’s discography, marking his expansion into television scoring after a successful career in film and video game soundtracks. His work on Halt and Catch Fire was released by Lakeshore Records and later by Fire Records, highlighting its critical acclaim and cult following. The soundtrack received praise for its ability to capture the show’s mood and era, with reviewers noting its nuanced approach and Haslinger’s skill in weaving together period-specific sounds with contemporary electronic techniques. The album’s success further cemented Haslinger’s reputation as a leading composer in the electronic and television music worlds.
